steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In November 2023, Equity Mates reported GSK would pay 23andMe $20 million for one year of non-exclusive access to anonymised customer DNA data to support drug research, illustrating how GSK sources data to inform its pharmaceutical development efforts.

episode.title: 23andMe is selling access to customer's DNA

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In March 2026, a guest on Equity Mates said GSK sat in an opportunistic bucket due to a short-term inflexion the market was missing, adding that concerns about its pipeline development were overdone according to a healthcare analyst.

episode.title: 4 steps to find winning software stocks with Ben Arnold

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?
Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In March 2026, a guest on Equity Mates placed GSK in a value-tilted opportunistic sleeve, calling it unloved in the UK and Europe and expecting a 12 to 18 month inflexion that the market had not recognised.

episode.title: 4 steps to find winning software stocks with Ben Arnold

views.text: In January 2026, Equity Mates noted the UK stock market looked cheap and that pharmaceuticals were a beaten up sector, highlighting GSK as a major index constituent and implying subdued valuations in parts of the market.
